title: docs-deploy params
description: Operator-facing config keys for the docs-deploy bundle — ADR-0081's locked decision: bundle params validate against JSON Schema. token_env/secret_env are secret NAMES, never values.

worktree_base.description: driver-git base — worktrees and the clone cache live under it.

token_env.description: NAME of the secret holding the forge token (clone auth + gh-pages push + status posts). Never the value. Must match the $<name> the deploy cmd's credential.helper echoes — the shipped cmd assumes BUPHA_TOKEN.

timeout.description: Inner shell timeout in seconds (driver cap: 600).

context.description: GitHub commit-status context posted on the pushed docs-branch sha.

main_ref.description: Ref the gen-dependent repos' second worktree checks out at the run root (<run>), so docs:deploy's `cd ..` gen steps (cargo run/doc) see the main checkout. Ignored by the self-contained repos.

cmd.description: Deploy command run at the worktree root (= the docs branch root). Default: bun install (frozen-lockfile, plain fallback) + env-scoped git credential.helper/author + `bun run docs:deploy`. Override per-install; keep the credential.helper export or gh-pages pushes will be anonymous.
